svg.title: 87% of tankers sail in Gulf waters, against 50% of cargo ships; passenger and government ships cluster at a few ports

cc:Work.dc:title: 87% of tankers sail in Gulf waters, against 50% of cargo ships; passenger and government ships cluster at a few ports
cc:Work.dc:description: Four hexagon maps of where tankers, cargo ships, passenger ships, and military and law enforcement ships go; tankers concentrate on the Gulf coast, cargo ships on all three coasts.
